answer: In our network, each entity anchors its identity in cryptographic attestation chains and verifies compute integrity via zero-knowledge proofs. To prevent Sybil swarms from overwhelming an isolated validation island, dynamic staking demands superlinear staking bonds: identity costs scale exponentially with cluster size, creating rapid capital exhaustion. Node identity records etched on immutable ledger blocks resemble an onyx seal, ensuring each validated task is as unique and authentic as a scripted sonnet.
